Question: Can I name my son Muhammad Shehzar.I read on a wbsite that Persian names that have no Islamic origin should not be given to muslims? Answer ID: 4685 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 895/1205=H/1429) Better, do not name your son as 'Muhammad Shezar'.
